CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 05 / 12

Production possibilities frontier (PPF)

PPF locationsPPF 位置判讀

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify feasible, infeasible, efficient and inefficient points; explain why a point inside the frontier indicates unused or misallocated resources.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

邊界上具生產效率，內部可行但有資源閒置或分配不當，外部在現有條件下不可達。由內部改善可同時增加產量。

Points on the PPF are productively efficient; points inside are feasible but inefficient. Points outside are infeasible with current resources and technology. Moving from an interior point toward the frontier can increase output without sacrificing the other good.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：With X+Y≤10, (4,4) is interior, (4,6) is on the frontier, and (6,6) is outside. 三點分別代表無效率、效率、不可行。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

If X+Y≤10, how is (3,5) classified? 如何分類？
